grandline.handbook.title: Captain's Handbook
grandline.handbook.p1:
§lCaptain's Handbook§r

The sea is wide and it does not forgive. You get one life: when you fall you are knocked down, and if no friend lifts you before the clock runs out, your story ends.

The world remembers: your grave, your bounty, and the fruit you leave behind.
grandline.handbook.p2:
§lFighting§r

%1$s: Combat Mode. Number keys 1-9 become abilities.
%2$s: next ability set (weapon, fruit, Haki, race).
Left click: combo. Hold: heavy.
Right click: guard; tap on the hit to parry.
%3$s: dodge.
%4$s: lock on.
grandline.handbook.p3:
§lHaki§r

%1$s: Observation. Sense foes through walls and sidestep blows.
%2$s: Armament. Harden your fists and blade; it is the only way to strike a Logia.
%3$s: Conqueror's, if you were born with it. Few are.

Haki grows by using it.
grandline.handbook.p4:
§lDevil Fruits§r

One fruit to a person; a second one kills. Eat one and the sea becomes your enemy: water and seastone drain you. When a user dies, the fruit is reborn somewhere in the world.

%1$s: transform (Zoan).
Master your fruit and survive its trial to awaken it.
grandline.handbook.p5:
§lShips§r

Shipwrights sell and upgrade ships and raise sunk ones. At the helm: W/S sails, A/D rudder, %1$s anchor, %2$s Coup de Burst.
Walk the deck while she sails; the hatch leads below to the hold.
A coating from Sabaody lets a ship dive.
grandline.handbook.p6:
§lNavigation§r

%1$s: sea chart.
The four Blues are calm. Reverse Mountain climbs into the Grand Line, where a Log Pose is the only compass that works. Between the seas lie the Calm Belts: no wind, and Sea Kings below.
Dockworkers sell passage between islands you know.
grandline.handbook.p7:
§lBounties and Factions§r

Piracy, brawls and crimes raise your bounty and put your face on posters. Marines arrest the downed and the wanted; outlaws rob them.
You chose a path when you were made. After your first voyage, your island's elder sets you on its road.
grandline.handbook.p8:
§lPeople§r

Talk to anyone. Elders, captains and named characters hand out work and stories; notice boards hold odd jobs. Some will sail with you if you earn it: a shipwright, a cook, a doctor, a navigator...
Crewmates fight beside you and can lift you when you fall.
grandline.handbook.p9:
§lGrowing Stronger§r

%1$s: character sheet. Spend stat points, pick your style, set your ability slots.
Every weapon, style, fruit and Haki has its own mastery; using them unlocks new techniques. Masters in the towns teach new styles.
grandline.handbook.p10:
§lA Last Word§r

Storms roam the Grand Line, the sky holds islands of cloud, and somewhere far below the waves there is a city in a bubble.

Set sail.
